verdict.rationale: A public status page with incident history is a fair question for an AI inference cloud, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, uptime history, or incident reports. Flex-tier 'occasional resource unavailability' and fail_fast 429 behavior are adjacent request-handling features, not a status page, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can check a public status page with incident history before betting production traffic on the platform
